evidence.note: Sets up a Task tracking system, but only 3 coarse milestones rather than a per-task ledger of the 37; establishes tracking without fine granularity.
Runs each protocol type and produces per-type score summaries (STS/classification/clustering/retrieval), keeping an inventory of what has been run and its outputs.
'Note expected scores' — explicitly records reference/expected values while tasks run, showing it does not conflate 'running' with 'correct'.
Runs structural (run_eval) checks per type — the harness's structural-only signal.
A separate dedicated phase cross-referencing MTEB leaderboard values, distinct from the structural checks, demonstrating it distinguishes structural-green from number-checked.
Counts final result keys to confirm all task blocks present before treating the job complete.

reasoning: The agent kept a clear (if coarse) inventory and explicitly separated structural validity (run_eval checks) from numerical reconciliation against the MTEB reference, recording expected scores and running a dedicated cross-check phase — clearly above anchor 3's conflation of structural-with-correct. But it did not maintain a live per-task ledger flagging which of the 37 tasks were still unreconciled, nor re-verify downstream tasks after shared-code edits, which anchor 8 requires. This lands squarely at anchor 5.
